harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf, verified live application and reboot persistence.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: accept_redirects and accept_source_route were enabled (1) on all/default/ens2/lo except conf.all.accept_source_route which was already 0
Applied config live with sudo sysctl --system, verified all interfaces (all/default/ens2/lo) reported 0 for both settings
Captured pre-restart boot_id and sysctl proof
Triggered a safe single-node reboot (shutdown -r now) that allowed the acknowledgement to return before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned

Verified boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just elapsed time) and confirmed all sysctl values remained 0 for accept_redirects and accept_source_route across all/default/ens2/lo post-reboot

evidence.summary: accept_redirects=1 and accept_source_route=1 (default/ens2/lo) prior to change; captured boot_id e4e401d2...

evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created for ICMP redirect and source-route hardening
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf setting accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 for all, default, ens2, and lo
sudo sysctl --system applied the file; per-interface check showed all/default/ens2/lo all report accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline with boot identity
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id e4e401d2-3dd8-48c6-848a-545631b9e229 and confirmed sysctl values still 0 immediately before restart
Backgrounded shutdown -r now via nohup; command returned with connection closed by remote host, confirming the ack was received before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Polling showed connection refused then success; post-restart boot_id d97308f3-a673-43b1-95e1-e0384661f2da differs from pre-restart e4e401d2-3dd8-48c6-848a-545631b9e229, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery/persistence of the hardening settings
evidence.summary: After reboot, net.ipv4.conf.{all,default,ens2,lo}.accept_redirects and .accept_source_route all read 0, confirming the sysctl.d config persisted and reapplied at boot
